player_intro: (DeckTech handle '''CannedMunki''') posted a [[Dark]] list on DeckTech in February 2001.
shields_note: The post names no Defensive Shields.
notes: TITLE WITHHELD: the published title 'its the @#$%' is a censored swear word.

The list as posted is one location ('Dagoba', posted run together with its 'Locations' header) and 59 copies of the Dagobah Interrupt Fear ('Interrupts Fear X 59'; the description reads '59 fears'). Dested as posted: Dagobah is the Dark Special Edition system; Fear is the Dark Dagobah Interrupt. Total 60 as published.
